description: Google Images results for a query, twenty a page: for each image its URL, width and height, its thumbnail with width and height, and the page it is on. `response.next_cursor` fetches the next twenty (null after the last page). Billing per call: 1 Credits.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of a previous answer, unchanged, for the next twenty images.
cursor.title: cursor

filter.description: `0` includes the results Google omits as very similar to others.
filter.title: filter

nfpr.description: `1` searches exactly the query as typed, without Google's spelling correction.
nfpr.title: nfpr

q.description: Search query. Google's search operators work: `adele site:youtube.com`, `intitle:paris`, `query -exclude`.
q.title: q

safe.description: SafeSearch: `active` filters explicit results, `off` does not.
safe.title: safe

tbs.description: Google's image filters, e.g. `isz:l` (large), `itp:face` (faces), `ic:gray` (black and white), `qdr:w` (past week).
tbs.title: tbs

name: get_v2
title: Search Images
